method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (mai-core.l4, nine regulative rules; the s 51D start is a DO rule, its lapse no breach), date helpers (mai-dates.l4, no daydate import, no YMD) and a seat layer (mai-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Motor Accident Insurance Act 1994 (Qld) (act-1994-009), current in-force version on 22 September 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1994-009.txt. Not deposited and asked as facts: the Motor Accident Insurance Regulation 2018 (notice contents), the s 100A offer limits and declared costs limit, the period of limitation (Limitation of Actions Act 1974).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run mai-dates.l4 ; l4 run mai-core.l4 ; l4 run mai-seat.l4 ; l4 run mai-cases-claimant.l4
checks.result: 153 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-11-07); 9 #TRACEs with an expect line, each ending in the expected breach
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the claimant, Part 4 claims machinery: s 4 (claim, claimant, motor vehicle accident); ss 31(1), 32, 33(2)-(3); s 34; s 37AA; s 37(2)-(3) with s 40; s 37A(3); s 39(1)(a), (3), (5), (8); s 41(1), (3), (5); s 42(1), (3); ss 45(2)-(3), 47(2); s 51(9)-(9A); ss 51A(1)-(3), 51B(5), 51C(1), (6), 51D; s 52(1)-(2); s 55F(1)-(3); s 57(1)-(3), (5). Out: Parts 1-3 and 5-9 other than s 4 (machinery, insurer licensing and supervision, offences), s 31(3)-(4) trailers, duties of the insured person (ss 35-36, 43-44) and of law practices (ss 36A-36E, 37AB, 39A, 41A), notice contents (regulation not deposited), multiple insurers (ss 37(4), 38, 52(3)-(7), 52A), expert reports (ss 45A-46B), disclosure and enforcement (ss 48-50), rehabilitation services (s 51(1)-(8), (10)), conference procedure (ss 51B other than (5), 51C(2)-(5), (7)-(11)), ss 53-55, 55F(4)-(7), 57(4), 57A-60, and the s 57 leave route.
seat: the claimant (the person injured in a motor vehicle accident, a person claiming for them, or for a fatal injury the dependants or estate)
